section_path: MMI Daily Iron Ore Index Report October 7 2026
section_path_text: MMI Daily Iron Ore Index Report October 7 2026
summary:
Main
Seaborne indices and mainstream brand quotations continued to soften, although not every product declined.On Oct 7, the MMi 61% index fell to USD 91.25/dmt and the 65% to 109.70, with their spread widening slightly to USD 18.45. PB, Newman and Mac Fines each lost USD 0.40, while Jimblebar Fines and SP10 were unchanged. This looks more like continued adjustment amid cautious buying than a clear trend reversal.
